title: blush-rendering.json (consumed by BeautyBlushConfiguration.decode)
description: Rendering and tracking only. Placement, silhouettes and pigment distribution live in makeup-reference.database.json. Every key is required and validated in Swift; unknown keys are rejected.

mask_asset.description: Bundled brush mask sampled by non-reference looks (BeautyBlush.metal blushAtlasFragment).

paint_feather.description: Width of the brush-mask threshold ramp in non-reference looks. Unit: fraction of the mask range.

coverage.description: Global multiplier on pigment alpha. Unit: ratio.

absorption.description: Optical density of the absorbing layer: per-channel transmittance exp(-absorption*(1-shade/max(shade))). Unit: unitless density.

saturation.description: How much of the shade's own colour (at the skin's luminance) replaces the low-frequency skin colour in the body term. Unit: ratio.

pigment_mix.description: Balance between the absorbing layer (0) and the pigment body (1). Unit: ratio.

detail_radius_px.description: Radius of the low-frequency skin the pigment colours; pores, fine texture and highlights finer than this are kept from the camera. Unit: camera pixels.

min_cutoff_hz.description: One Euro minimum cutoff for per-vertex mesh residual smoothing (rigid pose is not filtered). Unit: Hz.

velocity_beta.description: One Euro speed coefficient for the same smoothing. Unit: per metre/second.

visibility_tau_seconds.description: Time constant of the pigment fade in/out. Unit: seconds.

mask_max_age_seconds.description: Face-skin mask age still treated as fresh. Unit: seconds.

mask_fade_seconds.description: Fade after a mask stops being fresh. Unit: seconds.

max_yaw_degrees.description: Face angle to the camera beyond which pigment hides. Unit: degrees.

stretch_fade.description: Surface area ratio current/rest of the mesh: fade in from [0] to [1], fade out from [2] to [3]. Strictly increasing.

target_fps.description: Render cap at nominal temperature. Unit: frames per second.

thermal_fps.description: Render cap at serious or critical thermal state. Unit: frames per second.
